# `Q-12-2` — Inline Listing Contents Not Yet Supported

> Inline `contents:` records are not yet supported and the entry
> is skipped.

## What this means

The `contents:` key of a listing accepts a list of paths or
globs that tell Quarto which documents to include. In Quarto 1,
each entry could also be an *inline record* — an object with
fields like `title`, `path`, `date` — so that a listing could
mix real files with hand-written entries.

Quarto 2 does not yet implement inline-record entries. When the
parser sees one, it emits this warning and drops the entry from
the listing.

## Why this happens

Most often: a Quarto 1 listing configuration was copied verbatim
into a Quarto 2 project, and one or more of the `contents:`
entries is an object rather than a path or glob.

## How to fix

Two options while the feature is being implemented:

- **Move each inline entry to a real file** in the listing's
  source directory, with the metadata expressed as the file's
  own front matter.
- **Wait for the feature.** Track progress at the Quarto issue
  tracker; the feature is on the roadmap.

## Related

- `Q-12-1` — other shapes of listing configuration the parser
  does not yet support.
